literal_meaning: কর্তার ভজক বা কর্তাকে ভজনকারী (leader's worshipper or devotee)
figurative_meaning_en: Sycophants or flatterers of those in power, bootlickers or yes-men
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কর্তাভজা হয়ে নেতার সব কথা মেনে নেয়।
দলের কর্তাভজারা সবসময় বসের প্রশংসা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He acts like a bootlicker, agreeing with everything the leader says.
The party's yes-men always praise the boss to gain favor.
history: The idiom derives from the Kartabhaja sect, an 18th-century Bengali Vaishnava tradition founded by Ajitananda Ray, emphasizing esoteric worship of the guru or 'karta' (leader), metaphorically extended to blind followers of powerful figures.
note: The term has roots in a specific religious sect, adding layers to its cultural usage in critiquing unquestioning loyalty.
